name: BK Butler Tube Driver (catalogue 111000)
description: BK Butler Tube Driver: a TL072 input buffer, an inverting TL072 gain stage whose feedback resistor is the 500 kOhm 'Tube Drive' pot (C5 120 pF across it), and a real starved 12AX7 cascade. IC1b drives grid 1 (pin 7) through C6 10 nF and R6 10 kOhm with a 10 kOhm grid return to V-; both 12AX7 cathodes sit on V- and both plates are loaded by 68 kOhm to V+ (about 34 V across each triode). Plate 1 feeds grid 2 through C7 47 nF, R9 10 kOhm and a 10 kOhm return to V-. The tone network is the pedal's own: C8 330 pF (treble) across R13 the 500 kOhm HI pot with R14 220 kOhm to the mid node, R12 22 kOhm into C9 100 nF and C10 47 nF/C11 47 nF with R16 2k2 and the 100 kOhm LO pot, and the 100 kOhm log Level pot after the HI wiper. D1/D2 1N4148 clamp the buffer's input node to a 1 kOhm/22 uF filtered V+ node and to V-. Supply: the 12.6 V AC adapter's half-wave voltage doubler, modelled as the two rails it produces (+17 V / -17 V), see the notes.

sources.title: J. D. Sleep, 'Tube Driver' schematic, General Guitar Gadgets, revision 2003-12-09 (redraw of the Chandler/Butler Tube Driver): complete signal path and values - C1 0.033 uF, R1 10k, R2 1M, C2 47 pF, D1/D2 1N4148 with R3 1k/C3 22 uF, IC1a buffer, C4 5 uF, R4 1k5, IC1b with R5 500 kOhm log 'Tube Drive' and C5 120 pF, C6 0.01 uF, R6 10k, R7 10k, R8/R11 68k, 12AX7, C7 0.047 uF, R9/R10 10k, C8 330 pF, R12 22k, R13 500 kOhm linear 'Hi', R14 220k, C9 0.1 uF, R15 100 kOhm linear 'Lo', C10/C11 0.047 uF, R16 2k2, R17 100 kOhm log 'Level'; supply 12.6 V AC secondary with R18 10R/1W, D3/D4 1N4007, R19 470, R20 1k and 470 uF reservoirs

Chandler Industries 'Tube Driver' (the licensed BK Butler design): the pedal this redraw is of; the Butler original uses the same op-amp -> starved 12AX7 -> HI/LO/Level topology. No second independent schematic was obtainable from this machine (freestompboxes, reddit and the datasheet mirror hosts refuse or do not resolve); the values here are from the GGG redraw alone and each one is marked in its part note
N. Koren, 'Improved vacuum tube models for SPICE' (12AX7 set), the library card used for both triodes

controls.label: Drive
controls.note: R5 500 kOhm log 'Tube Drive' pot, the feedback resistor of the inverting IC1b stage (C5 120 pF in parallel). 0 = 0 Ohm (unity, no drive), 1 = 500 kOhm against R4 1k5 (about +50 dB before the op-amp clips). Legacy 'Drive'

controls.label: Treble (HI)
controls.note: R13 500 kOhm linear HI pot: its wiper is the tone-stack output that feeds the Level pot, R14 220 kOhm takes the wiper back to the stack's mid node. Legacy 'Tone'

controls.label: Bass (LO)
controls.note: R15 100 kOhm linear LO pot, wired as the rheostat between the stack's mid node and the C11/R16 bass node. The catalogue has no bass parameter for this unit

controls.label: Level
controls.note: R17 100 kOhm log Level pot from the tone-stack output to ground; its wiper is the output jack. The catalogue has no volume parameter for this unit (the legacy model folded level into its Mix)

controls.label: Feedback
controls.note: The legacy model's feedback amount. The pedal has no feedback control: its only in-loop element is the Drive pot itself. Stored only

controls.label: Mix
controls.note: The legacy model's dry/wet mix. The Tube Driver is a single series path from jack to jack (no blend). Stored only

controls.label: FB (-)
controls.note: Legacy negative-feedback trim; no part in the pedal. Stored only

controls.label: Gate
controls.note: Legacy noise gate; the pedal has none. Stored only

controls.label: On/Off
controls.note: Host bypass (the pedal's true-bypass footswitch). The netlist is the effect-on path. Stored only

parts.label: V+ (12.6 V AC adapter doubler)
parts.note: unverified: the GGG drawing shows the 12.6 V AC secondary, R18 10R/1W, D4 1N4007, R19 470 and two 470 uF reservoirs; that is a half-wave doubler giving about +17.0 V (17.8 V peak less the diode and the R19 drop at the pedal's ~20 mA). Modelled as the rail it produces, with the note that no mains ripple is represented; the pedal's idle draw makes it a few tens of mV

parts.label: V- (same doubler, negative half)
parts.note: unverified: D3 1N4007, R20 1k and the 470 uF pair give about -16.4 V; -17 V is used so both halves are symmetric (the GGG drawing's two halves differ only by R19/R20)

parts.label: Input clamp to the filtered V+ node
parts.note: The GGG drawing's D1/D2 sit on the buffer's input node with a 1 kOhm/22 uF node above them; read as the input clamps they are (they only conduct above about +16 V). Whatever their original purpose, they are inaudible at pedal levels, so the reading does not colour the sound

parts.label: Input buffer (unity gain)
parts.note: Unity-gain buffer. Modelled as the engine's nullor (level 0): the TL072 macro with a 1 Ohm unity feedback has two spurious saturated DC solutions of +/-137885 V in ngspice (the macro's 137885 DC gain against tanh limiting) that .nodeset does not remove, while the engine's source stepping finds 0 V. A nullor is exact for a buffer whose input never leaves +/-16 V, and the D1/D2 clamps are kept

parts.label: Input resistor of the drive stage
Tube Drive
parts.note: Rheostat: wiper tied to the inverting-input end, so the resistance falls to 0 Ohm at 0 (CCW) and is 500 kOhm at 1

parts.label: Treble feed into the HI pot
HI wiper to the stack's mid node
LO (bass), rheostat mid-node to bass node
